title: The Midnight Typewriter
summary: A 45-second Canvas 2D animated film where typed ink rises from a lamplit attic typewriter into swallows, a steam train, boats, and stars.
description: A 45-second illustrated Canvas 2D film. At a lamplit attic desk, a mechanical typewriter prints four lines of verse whose ink lifts off the page into swallows, a miniature steam train, paper boats, and constellations under the gaze of a ginger cat before one initial returns to begin again.
